user_input: Which mitigation options have direct, active mitigates relationships in Enterprise ATT&CK 17.1 to the technique mapped to ThunderShell in AA23-165A? Start from LockBit affiliates and follow the three-hop actor-to-software-to-technique-to-mitigation path. Distinguish advisory observations from reference recommendations.
response:
LockBit affiliates' ThunderShell activity is related to Impair Defenses (T1562). [E8, E10]
Pre-compromise (M1056) is a mitigation for Develop Capabilities (T1587), Email Addresses (T1589.002), and Compromise Accounts (T1586). [E2, E4, E6]
Execution Prevention (M1038) is a mitigation for Impair Defenses (T1562). [E8]
User Account Management (M1018) is a mitigation for Impair Defenses (T1562). [E10]
